adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Epilepsy, ataxia, sensorineural deafness, hypokalemic alkalosis and biallelic KCNJ10 loss identify EAST/SeSAME; the direct renal defect is reduced basolateral Kir4.1 potassium conductance in DCT cells.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: NKCC2/ROMK/NCC defects can cause salt-wasting phenotypes, but none is the protein encoded by KCNJ10; ENaC activation would not fit the gene or syndrome.
